answer: A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The prism counter is kept in ember and nadir publishes each reset. Someone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3944 identities would post 3431 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
